newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia says power company not up for sale.
newsitem.headline: Zambia says power company not up for sale.

text.p: Zambia's state-run hydro-electric power company -- which currently enjoys a monopoly -- is not scheduled to be sold in the country's ongoing privatisation of state assets, Energy Minister Mann Muyuni said on Tursday.

"The government has no immediate plans to privatise the Zambia Electricity Supply Corporation (ZECSO). The government in its wisdom, has not included it among the companies earmarked for sale," Muyuni told Reuters.
He said the government had decided not to sell ZESCO because it had a good performance record and occupied a central place in the economy.

Other assets the government has decided not to privatise were the state-run media organisations, including Zambia National Broadcasting Corporation, the Times of Zambia, the Zambia Daily Mail and the Zambia News Agency, Muyuni said.
